gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-puritan: Capture Smallz comes in raw and tactical, with fat lowercase that fills the line like it means it. But Puritan is where the friendliness lives: rounded forms, open to the side, with oversized e and a counters.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-radio-canad: Raw and tactical, Capture Smallz stamps out chunky lowercase. Radio Canada Big does the quieter work as a plain sans: monoline strokes and terminals that finish well away from the stem, with an x-height filling the line.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-roboto: Capture Smallz comes in raw and tactical, with fat lowercase that fills the line like it means it. Roboto, a plain sans with generous mouths on its round letters, would keep paragraphs flowing without a snag.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-savate: Capture Smallz is raw and tactical, with lowercase swollen to a bold, blocky size. Savate, a contemporary sans, has open jaws on every curve and a tall round o, so paragraphs would glide along.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-sintony: Rough, chunky and loud, Capture Smallz stuffs each line with fat lowercase letters that practically leap right forward. Sintony, a plain sans, then cools things down with smooth, unclogged curves.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-sono: Puffed-up, raw and tactical: that is Capture Smallz, with lowercase built like a heavyweight. And that heading earns its keep big and short, while Sono, a sans-serif, stretches out with wide spacing and lofty lowercase.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-tiktok-sans: Fat, raw lowercase with a tactical edge sits up top. Capture Smallz makes the noise, then TikTok Sans steps in with an x-height near cap height and a spacious c, keeping the text moving.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-ubuntu-sans: Raw, tactical and chunky, Capture Smallz sits against Ubuntu Sans, whose curves look like bent copper pipe with the loops left open. Shrink the heading and that swagger fades fast.
gen-dafont-college-gf-aldrich: Dynamic and authoritative, College keeps every curve as stout as its stems. Aldrich comes in with an x-height near cap height and cupped rounds, so the two feel spun from one thick thread.
gen-dafont-college-gf-anek-kannada: Cable bent into shapes: College never swells or thins, so every curve holds firm. Anek Kannada lifts its x-height like a squared-off woodblock letter, with terminals stopping far from the stem.
